category_specific_evidence: Special value inf: np.dot([1,1], [-np.inf, np.inf]) should set the CPU invalid flag on the NaN result, but NumPy did not catch it (issue#14925).
NaN enters through the dot result: the invalid-value flag should be raised on the NaN produced by the inf inputs.
